title: False Teachers and True Wealth, Fight the Good Fight of Faith

questions.question: Let all who are under a yoke as bondservants regard their own masters as worthy of all ____, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be reviled.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:1 (ESV): "Let all who are under a yoke as bondservants regard their own masters as worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be reviled."

questions.question: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that accords with ____, he is puffed up with conceit...
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:3-4 (ESV): "If anyone teaches a different doctrine and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that accords with godliness, he is puffed up with conceit and understands nothing."

questions.question: Such a person has an unhealthy craving for controversy and for quarrels about words, producing envy, dissension, slander, base suspicions, and constant friction among people depraved in mind imagining that ____ is a means of gain.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:5 (ESV): "and constant friction among people who are depraved in mind and deprived of the truth, imagining that godliness is a means of gain."

questions.question: But godliness with ____ is great gain.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:6 (ESV): "But godliness with contentment is great gain,"

questions.question: For we brought nothing into the world, and we cannot take ____ out of the world.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:7 (ESV): "for we brought nothing into the world, and we cannot take anything out of the world."

questions.question: But if we have ____ and clothing, with these we will be content.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:8 (ESV): "But if we have food and clothing, with these we will be content."

questions.question: But those who desire to be ____ fall into temptation, into a snare, into many senseless and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:9 (ESV): "But those who desire to be rich fall into temptation, into a snare, into many senseless and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction."

questions.question: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:10 (ESV): "For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils. It is through this craving that some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pangs."

questions.question: But as for you, O man of God, ____ these things.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:11 (ESV): "But as for you, O man of God, flee these things. Pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, gentleness."

questions.question: Pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:11 (ESV): "Pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, gentleness."

questions.question: Fight the good fight of the ____. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:12 (ESV): "Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called and about which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses."

questions.question: Who alone has immortality, who dwells in unapproachable ____, whom no one has ever seen or can see.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:16 (ESV): "who alone has immortality, who dwells in unapproachable light, whom no one has ever seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal dominion. Amen."

questions.question: As for the rich in this present age, charge them not to be ____, nor to set their hopes on the uncertainty of riches, but on God.
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:17 (ESV): "As for the rich in this present age, charge them not to be haughty, nor to set their hopes on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy."

questions.question: They are to do good, to be rich in good works, to be ____ and ready to share,
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:18 (ESV): "They are to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous and ready to share,"

questions.question: O Timothy, guard the ____ entrusted to you. Avoid the irreverent babble and contradictions of what is falsely called "knowledge,"
questions.explanation: 1 Timothy 6:20 (ESV): "O Timothy, guard the deposit entrusted to you. Avoid the irreverent babble and contradictions of what is falsely called 'knowledge,'"

key_verse_text: But godliness with contentment is great gain, for we brought nothing into the world, and we cannot take anything out of the world. But if we have food and clothing, with these we will be content. But those who desire to be rich fall into temptation, into a snare, into many senseless and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction. For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils.
